verdict.rationale: A real-time communications SDK could plausibly ship AI-generated insights, such as call analytics or meeting summaries, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers messaging, audio, video, screen sharing, data messages and PSTN/SIP features, with nothing on AI-generated insights or suggestions. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes concern documentation accessibility, not in-product AI insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
